allowlist.reason: A file input only backs the Material button that opens the system file picker.
The one-pixel, tab-order-free input inside mfe-date-field and mfe-file-picker is the platform date and file picker engine; the visible control is the Material outlined field and button drawn over it.
Home destination cards are tab buttons drawn as Material outlined cards with a hand-built state layer, because Material Web has no card-button component.

renderer.scope: source renderer with a stubbed preload bridge; the installed application is not covered
